completion:
Consider your objectives and identify the key messages that you need to convey.
3. Describe the fire-safety issues in terms of non-compliance with the law.
   i) What law is being broken?
   ii) Who has the responsibility to comply with that law?
   iii) In what way is the law being broken?
   iv) What is the risk?
4. Identify what needs to be done to ensure compliance, in terms of risk (see above).
5. Precise and objective language.
   i) No speculation.
   ii) Avoid classical building and construction terminology.
   iii) Describe what you saw.
6. Explain clearly and concisely what the building owner needs to do, to ensure compliance with the law.
   i) Pick actions and advice that are achievable within the scope of any Remedial Action Plan (RAP).
